name: Lovable
tagline: Describe an app and have AI build it
description: Lovable is an AI app builder that works on a credit system. Its pricing page names Free, Pro, Business and Enterprise plans.
features: Credit-based building (default mode varies by task; Plan Mode costs 1 credit per message)
Cloud credits and credits for AI features in your apps
useCases: Building a web app from a description
strengths: Free plan with daily build credits
limitations: Credits expire (monthly plan credits after 2 months)
Apps with significant traffic can incur hosting costs paid from credits

plans.name: Free
highlights: 5 build credits per day, up to 30 per month

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: Monthly view. 100 monthly credits, credit rollovers, custom domains and user roles. A Yearly toggle ('2 months free') exists; yearly prices were not read.

plans.name: Business
plans.note: Monthly view. 100 Business credits plus team workspace, SSO and priority support.

free.details: Daily grant of 5 build credits (up to 30 per month), 20 Cloud credits monthly, and 4 credits for AI features in your apps.

pricing.regional: Some regional plans cap daily build credits at 30 per month. Tax treatment: not stated.
notes: Example costs listed: 0.50 credits to change a button colour, 1.20 to add authentication, 1.70 for a landing page with 3 generated images. Top-up credit prices are not stated.

verification.notes: Product active. Page shows a Monthly / Yearly (2 months free) toggle with Monthly figures: Free $0 (no card needed); Pro $25/month with 100 monthly credits; Business $50/month with 100 Business credits; Enterprise volume-based with a platform fee. Yearly prices were not read. Corrected: Pro and Business prices were previously not captured.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

keyFeature: Describe an app and have AI build it

profile.headline: Describe an app in plain language and get working, editable software

capabilities.title: Build a full-stack app from a description
capabilities.text: Lovable generates the frontend, backend, database, authentication and integrations from a natural-language prompt.

capabilities.title: Keep the code
capabilities.text: Each project produces a codebase that can sync to GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket, so it can join an existing engineering workflow.

capabilities.title: Iterate in a chat beside a live preview
capabilities.text: Ask for one change at a time, point at an element in the preview, or edit text inline.

capabilities.title: Publish to a live address
capabilities.text: One click on Publish deploys the app to a lovable.app URL, and later changes go live when you publish them again.

featureCards.name: Workspaces and projects
featureCards.text: A workspace holds projects, members, billing and a shared pool of credits; each project is one app.

featureCards.name: Chats
featureCards.text: Conversations outside a project for thinking through ideas, which can send work to a project when something needs building.

featureCards.name: Connectors
featureCards.text: Link your apps to the rest of your stack without writing integration code.

featureCards.name: Templates
featureCards.text: Start from a ready-made app and remix it on any plan.

featureCards.name: Security and governance
featureCards.text: Workspace roles, two-factor authentication, SSO, SCIM, audit logs and built-in security checks.

featureCards.name: Desktop, mobile and chat apps
featureCards.text: Build from the desktop or mobile app, in Slack or Telegram, or from ChatGPT and other AI tools through the Lovable MCP server.

audienceDetail.text: Product, operations, sales, marketing and finance teams replacing spreadsheets and per-seat software with their own apps.
Technical teams setting up projects and prototypes, and agencies delivering client work where code ownership matters.
People launching products or side projects on their own.

scenarios.title: Validate an idea with a working prototype
scenarios.text: Build a prototype with real data and logic before engineering commits to it.

scenarios.title: Replace a spreadsheet with an internal tool
scenarios.text: Describe the workflow and let Lovable build a dashboard or admin panel around it.

scenarios.title: Launch a landing page or portfolio
scenarios.text: Generate a marketing site, then publish it to a live URL.

scenarios.title: Build a small SaaS product
scenarios.text: Add login, a database and payments as follow-up prompts once the first version works.

gettingStarted.text: Sign up with email, Google, GitHub or Apple; the account comes with a personal workspace on the free plan.
Type a prompt into the box on the dashboard, or attach a screenshot or mockup as a visual reference.

gettingStarted.step: Refine one change at a time
gettingStarted.text: Check the preview after each request, including the mobile view.
Click Publish, adjust the suggested address, and send the link.
